purpose: Phase-8A baseline resistance profile schema + policy. Every simulation begins with an EXPLICIT baseline resistance profile (intrinsic sensitivity, baseline resistant/tolerant fractions, pathway dependence, apoptosis/uptake competence, stress tolerance, microenvironment protection). The per-species baseline values live in resistance-context.registry.json; this registry defines the required fields, allowed missing-information states, and the rule that an UNKNOWN profile is NEVER defaulted to fully sensitive. Schematic; no measured baseline value is fabricated.

coefficient_policy.valid_range: baseline_resistant_fraction + baseline_tolerant_fraction in [0,1]; together they must leave a non-negative sensitive remainder
coefficient_policy.source: per-context predicted baseline heterogeneity (general melanoma biology); no direct baseline resistance dataset in the frozen package
coefficient_policy.sensitivity_note: baseline fractions seed the subpopulation model; they are the starting composition, not a measured baseline.
coefficient_policy.limitations: No measured baseline resistant-cell fraction or IC50 (all NOT_REPORTED).

rules.no_default_to_sensitive: An unknown baseline resolves to intrinsic_sensitivity='unknown' / NOT_REPORTED, never silently to fully sensitive.
rules.explicit_only: A simulation without an explicit baseline profile is UNSUPPORTED (idle), not assumed sensitive.
rules.fixed_baseline: Baseline is fixed per context; treatment-induced change is represented only by adaptive/acquired transitions.
